def power(a, b):
    ans = 1
    while b:
        ans = (ans * a) % MOD
        b -= 1
    return ans

p, k = map(int, input().split())
if k == 0:
    print(power(p, p - 1))
elif k == 1:
    print(power(p, p))
else:
    ord = 1
    cur = k
    while cur != 1:
        cur = (cur * k) % p
        ord += 1
    print(power(p, (p - 1) // ord))
